summary: Immutep filed a 6-K announcing a change to its American Depositary Share ratio, effective at the open on 28 September 2026, from 1 ADS = 10 ordinary shares to 1 ADS = 200 ordinary shares, functionally a 1-for-20 reverse split of the ADSs. The action responds to a Nasdaq notice that IMMP's closing bid price had been below US$1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, with the compliance period ending 26 October 2026. No shareholder approval is required; ordinary shares, capital structure and cash position are unchanged. BNY Mellon is depositary; fractional entitlements are cashed out. Watch whether the bid price holds at or above US$1.00 for the requisite 10-20 consecutive business days, since any renewed deficiency within 12 months attracts no additional cure period.
